column1: # Firmware the mainline kernel loads on the TB323FU, and where each file comes
# from on the tablet's own Android. The files are Lenovo/Qualcomm binaries and
# are NOT in this repository: extract them from your device with
#   target      path under the Linux root filesystem
#   sha256      hash of the file extracted from Android build
#               hashes; that is a warning, not an error)
#   source      where it comes from on Android; "X.mdt + .bNN" means a split
#               PIL image that is merged back into one .mbn (pil-squash.py)
